claim: Patchline discharges the obligations a migration generates — NOT NULL and foreign-key constraints — against concrete sample rows, returning a proof of satisfaction when every row complies and a precise counterexample row when one does not, so a reviewer never has to guess whether existing data can satisfy a new constraint. The worker evaluates each obligation row by row, reports satisfiable/unsatisfiable, and on failure returns the first violating row. The gate proves a satisfiable NOT NULL obligation is discharged, an unsatisfiable one yields the offending null row, a satisfiable FK obligation passes, and an FK violation yields the row whose value is outside the allowed set.
